text: Mokuaꞌ limoh onu Pimipin Agama Yahudi deꞌ Paling Ayuh Ananiasduoh kudu-kudu pimipin ulang Yahudi deꞌ bokon nog toban tukangbela, deꞌ adon-e Tertulus  Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ ngaduap gubelnul Feliks, ngan-eyaꞌ ngadu salah Paulus tuduꞌ-e

Gubelnul moꞌ mogan Paulus odaꞌ ngaduapodop-e, Tertulus mulai nuduh Paulus in-e,“Gubelnul Feliks, moꞌ tuui takal-e ingan deꞌ mipin, koꞌih moꞌ mulai kiꞌansonang, dop-e bogoꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ moꞌ maju daang basa koꞌih odaꞌ bijak ingan.
Daki sijaꞌ-e koꞌih silalu tilimaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ nai ingan, koꞌih bisukul tuduꞌingan
Pak-e saꞌ-e diꞌ-e tuui saꞌat masa ingan, sabal dioꞌ niꞌ tiliaꞌ ngojitdioꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ yaꞌ ngadu koꞌih tuduꞌ ingan
Koꞌih moꞌ ningaꞌ nyaꞌa itih ulangpingaso deꞌ bahaya  Daki-daki sijaꞌ-e yoh odaꞌ ulang Yahudi bikaꞌi si odop-e.Iyoh leh deꞌ jadin pimipin soꞌ uluk nyaꞌa deꞌ nunaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ ngajal Yesussoꞌ Nazaret
Yoh lika suba kaꞌis Boli Topaꞌ, pak-e koꞌih moꞌ takap-e  Koꞌihyaꞌ bilituang duoh-e nunaꞌ atulan agama odop-e koꞌih
Lisias moꞌ odaꞌ koꞌihodi tuduꞌ ingan, moꞌ odop ingan deꞌ sikian totap ingan puꞌan nang onideꞌ ngadu koꞌih itih tok.”
Ulang-ulang Yahudi deꞌ ogiꞌ danoꞌ tuang suwaꞌnyalah Paulus, yoh nang suaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ sobot Tertulus inoh akan-e tok.

Gubelnul Feliks moꞌ tanon odaꞌ Paulus sina, Paulus moꞌ in-e, “Moꞌpuꞌan kuꞌ nang ingan moꞌ bisowaꞌ-sowaꞌ moꞌ jadin hakim basa koꞌih, nohleh ngan kuꞌ sonang tapod sina tanon nang odop kuꞌ diꞌ-e salah deꞌ jowiningan
Ingan soꞌon kalik nyaꞌa soꞌ ingan sikian-e dop-e simoong duwohonu deꞌ dioꞌ okuꞌ odi keꞌ Yerusalem nyomah Topaꞌ

Aluaꞌ doiꞌ sidoh nyaꞌadeꞌ mutiꞌ tapod okuꞌ bikalah duoh osi-osi-e, aluaꞌ doiꞌ nyaꞌa tapod okuꞌnguluk nyaꞌa odaꞌ bikaꞌi bait deꞌ Boli Topaꞌ bait deꞌ boli topat simayangduoh topat-topat deꞌ bokon daang kota
Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ diꞌ-e tapodtanon bukti oniꞌ deꞌ moꞌ ngadu-e inoh tuduꞌ ingan

Pak-e okuꞌ ngadutuduꞌ ingan nang okuꞌ nyomah Topaꞌ sumuk babai koꞌih nunaꞌ Olan deꞌtanon Topaꞌ Yesus  Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ nang okuꞌ salah, pak-e okuꞌ bisayaꞌsuaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ obuah nulis daang buk deꞌ nulis nabi Musa, duoh buk deꞌ nulisnabi-nabi deꞌ bokon
Okuꞌ samah kodaꞌ yoh deꞌ mutiꞌ geh, okuꞌ bisayaꞌnang Topaꞌ yaꞌ paliꞌ pakat nyaꞌa deꞌ moꞌ kobos odaꞌ paliꞌ idip, bait nyaꞌa deꞌpaguh bait nyaꞌa deꞌ jaꞌat!
Noh leh ngan kuꞌ silalu nai oniꞌ bonal-bonalnunaꞌ otin osuap kuꞌ, saꞌ diꞌ kuꞌ nai oniꞌ deꞌ jaꞌat tuduꞌ Topaꞌ baya manusia.
Kudu-kudu sowaꞌ deꞌ moꞌ dioꞌ okuꞌ moꞌ buꞌu togan Yerusalem, okuꞌmoꞌ paliꞌ toban duit deꞌ moꞌ masia koꞌih saꞌan basa odop koꞌih, duohsimoliah binatang saꞌan Topaꞌ
Takal okuꞌ mokuaꞌ nai adat kibisig odopkuꞌ, okuꞌ aluaꞌ simoliah binatang saꞌan Topaꞌ deꞌ Boli Topaꞌ  Kudu-kudunaꞌan ulang Yahudi soꞌ Asia kilin okuꞌ danoꞌ, doiꞌ-e nak ogiꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ bogoꞌdeꞌ bikaꞌi
Nyaꞌa deꞌ munoꞌ leh deꞌ patut nog ngadu okuꞌ tuduꞌ ingan,moꞌ nyam-e tok ogiꞌ salah kuꞌ
Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
Pak-e Feliks moꞌ bogoꞌ puꞌan oniꞌ deꞌ moꞌ ngajal Topaꞌ Yesus, moꞌkangan odop-e bilituang yoh moꞌ in-e, “Kajon Lisias komandan sidadu inohnog katiꞌ, ke okuꞌ motod ituang-e itih.”
Feliks moꞌ odaꞌ komandan pasukan sidadu inoh totap naan Paulus,pak-e diꞌ-e jolaꞌ ngilate-e, simoꞌ-e ogiꞌ dingan-dingan-e nog ngin oniꞌ deꞌpilelu-e diꞌ-e jaman-e.

Kudu-kudu onu mokuaꞌ inoh Feliks duoh sowon-e deꞌ adon Drusila,ulang Yahudi, odi keꞌ topat Paulus obuah naan, yoh moꞌ odaꞌ nyaꞌa tobanPaulus tuduꞌ odop-e, yoh moꞌ ngojit Paulus tanon loti bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ YesusKristus

Pak-e takal Paulus sina oniꞌ deꞌ bonal deꞌ boton Topaꞌ, nijonasong, duoh onu takal Topaꞌ bilituang duoh suaꞌ nyaꞌa, Feliks moꞌ tolu.Yoh moꞌ in-e, “Moh dioꞌ! Buu negeh adin, lopas tih okuꞌ mogan muꞌulagiꞌ.”
Yoh alap-alap nang Paulus ngin duit deꞌ odop-e, noh leh ngan-epaliꞌ-paliꞌ odaꞌ nyaꞌa mogan Paulus, odaꞌ odi sina duoh odop-e.
Pak-e takal sukup duwoh sowaꞌ, Perkius Festus moꞌ gati Feliks jadingubelnul  Saꞌ ulang Yahudi diꞌ-e buꞌui deꞌ odop-e, yoh moꞌ tanah Paulusodaꞌ totap daang jel.
